_source_note: UPI has no single published numeric decline-code standard the way card networks do (NPCI does not publish a public rulebook of this kind). These mnemonic codes and their soft/hard categorization are our own reasonable modeling of commonly-seen UPI failure reasons, not an official NPCI list. See notes/IDEA.md §9 for the same honesty point applied to retry limits.

PIN_ENTRY_TIMEOUT.description: Customer did not enter UPI PIN in time

COLLECT_REQUEST_EXPIRED.description: Collect request expired before being actioned

BANK_SERVER_UNREACHABLE.description: Issuing bank's server unreachable at time of request

INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.description: Insufficient balance in linked bank account

NPCI_SWITCH_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout at the NPCI switch routing the request

MANDATE_REVOKED.description: Customer revoked the UPI Autopay mandate

MANDATE_EXPIRED.description: UPI Autopay mandate validity period has ended

INVALID_VPA.description: Linked VPA is invalid or no longer exists

ACCOUNT_BLOCKED.description: Linked bank account blocked or frozen

TRANSACTION_DECLINED_BY_CUSTOMER.description: Customer actively declined the debit request
